description: This file is the entry point for the OrangeHRM web application, handling initial setup, environment configuration, and request routing.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Core application class responsible for handling HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, created from PHP globals.

classes.name: RedirectResponse
classes.description: HTTP response class for redirecting clients to another URL.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Request object from PHP global variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes objects like Framework and RedirectResponse.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Processes the incoming request and returns an appropriate response.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the HTTP response to the client.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Performs cleanup after the response has been sent.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the application is properly installed.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables debug mode for error handling.
